title: LiteSurvival
description: A lightweight modpack for lag-free survival and exploration.
body:
LiteSurvival is a lightweight yet feature-rich Fabric-based Minecraft 1.21.8 modpack, designed for private and public multiplayer survival servers. It focuses on performance, visuals, and quality-of-life improvements, making your gameplay smoother, more immersive, and highly customizable—without straying far from vanilla Minecraft.

Whether you’re exploring vast landscapes, managing your inventory, or building massive projects, this modpack ensures a lag-free and polished experience.

✨ Features
⚡ Performance Boosts

Sodium, Lithium – Optimized rendering, physics, and memory usage.

EntityCulling – Faster FPS and smarter rendering.

Sodium Extra & Reese’s Sodium Options – Custom performance settings.

🎨 Visual Enhancements

Iris Shaders – Full shader support for beautiful worlds.

Continuity & Chunks Fade In – Seamless connected textures and smoother chunk loading.

Gamma Utils & Clean F3 – Cleaner visuals and debugging.

🧰 Quality of Life

Roughly Enough Items (REI) – Simple recipe and item lookup.

Mouse Tweaks & Inventory Essentials – Better inventory management.

Cloth Config & Mod Menu – Easy configuration of all mods.

MiniHUD & Status Effect Bar – Quick info at a glance.

🌍 Exploration & Utilities

Trade Cycling & Placeholder API – Villager trading improvements.

Auto Clicker & Centered Crosshair – Small tools for convenience.

🛠 Building & Customization

Architecture API & MoreCulling – Enhanced building support.

Skin Layers 3D – Adds depth and style to player skins.

🔹 Why Choose SmoothCraft SMP?

✔️ Optimized for multiplayer survival servers
✔️ Keeps the vanilla feel with small but powerful improvements
✔️ Stable and FPS-friendly for both low-end and high-end PCs
✔️ Perfect for SMP communities or solo survival adventures

📌 Version & Requirements

Minecraft Version: 1.21.8

Loader: Fabric

Recommended RAM: 4GB+
